- HelixHealth: engineering + security (you mentioned Daniel + security lead)
- Redwood: myself (sales), Karthik Iyer (serving runtime), Ben Carter (ops/scale)

Please pick any one of these windows (we can do 60 or 90 min depending on preference):
- Option A: Tue Mar 21, 10:00–11:30 PT (90m)
- Option B: Wed Mar 22, 08:00–09:00 PT (60m) — tight but possible for focused walkthrough
- Option C: Thu Mar 23, 13:00–14:30 PT (90m)

Draft agenda (flexible):
1) 10 min — goals & success criteria (HelixHealth)
2) 25 min — infra & runtime overview (Karthik)
3) 25 min — live perf demo / example traces (Ben)
4) 20–35 min — focused Q&A, data flow, caching, and next steps / mutual action plan

Attached: post-discovery-recap.pdf (bulleted notes + attendees). I also created a quick poll if you'd prefer to lock a time: https://calendar.redwood.com/poll/HLX-TDX-3-options

Let me know which window works and whether we should make this 60 or 90 minutes. If you want your security lead on the call, please share their name/email and we’ll include a short SOC2 / data handling readout.

Thanks — jasmine
